fixed_contract.minimum_actual_buy_spacing: H+1 when every actual BUY E reserves new BUY decisions until E+H close; fixed H holds imply same spacing even without explicit reservation

assumptions: Ideal upper bound: every allowed signal is present, every BUY/SELL fills at first eligible session, enough funds and one-lot feasibility throughout. Real filters, rejected orders, failures and later sales can only reduce counts.

A BUY can be followed by a SELL decision at its completed close, but earliest actual SELL is the next evaluation session. A SELL may trigger a new BUY decision at its close, but the BUY is next session; no same-session round trip.
Indices in this evidence are one-based evaluation-session ordinals, not strategy history indices including2019-12-31.

derivation.fixed_hold_horizon_boundary: K_fixed >=83 requires 83*(H+1)<=1582; integer H<=18. This is necessary, not sufficient.
derivation.early_exit_with_reservation_kth_sale: Earliest S_k = E_k+1 = 62+(k-1)*(H+1), even if every cycle exits as early as possible.
derivation.early_exit_with_reservation_horizon_boun: K_early_reserved >=83 requires 82*(H+1)<=1580; integer H<=18. Early exits can close the final cycle sooner but cannot increase reserved entry rate.
derivation.boundary_H18: Uniform fixed H18 can ideally close83 cycles, frequency3.0328867235; last such sale is session1637. Five unused tail sessions cannot complete another H18 cycle.
derivation.boundary_H19: Uniform fixed H19 max79, earliest-exit reservation19 max80; both below83.
derivation.H20: Uniform fixed H20 max75 closed, frequency2.7405602923; with earliest exits but uniform reservation20 max76, frequency2.7771010962. Both fail the unchanged original frequency requirement.

validation.method: For each integer H1..100, enumerate ideal entries range(61,1643,H+1), count entry+H<=1642 and entry+1<=1642; each equals its corresponding analytic formula.

interpretation: 在当前60日启动、1642日分母和每60日至少3笔闭合目标下，全仓串行的统一固定H20必然不达频率；即使允许提前卖出，只要每周期仍保留E+20重新入场时钟，也必然不达。统一固定期限或统一保留时钟的整数H必要上限都是18。该推导直接展开既有目标，不是新增硬门，不证明H18或更短期限具有收益机制或可实盘达标。
limits: This does not rule out a strategy merely allowing maximum hold20 while some cycles are shorter and do not reserve20 sessions, nor mixed conditional horizon extensions; those require their own timing bound and actual CLOSED count.

Keeping reservation10 while selectively extending positions toH20 is a different clock contract; the uniform reservation20 bound cannot be applied to every cycle. It is not authorized or suggested by this evidence.
All-at-once hypothetical per-position H20 maturity labels are not account counts. Their existence does not remove the full-account frequency constraint.
No horizon is selected, no new experiment is locked, no budget is changed and no revenue efficacy ofH3/H5/H15/H18 is inferred.
